run_replace_subq_entities: run the script to replace sub-question entities with main-question entities using spacy NER
get_entlabel2ents: get a dictionary mapping entity labels to their extracted entity texts from a spacy doc
replace_entities_by_type: replace sub-question entities matching specific entity types with corresponding main-question entities
replace_entities_all_types: replace all sub-question entities regardless of type by falling back to any available main-question entity
run_debug_mode: run the script in debug mode to process only a few examples and print change statistics
